text:
Jordan Park: hi everyone! jordan here — just started today as a software engineer on the Inference team. remote first week. quick Qs: laptop ETA? who do I ping for VPC access/network setup? and any tips for getting dev creds quickly? fun fact: I build tiny wooden ukuleles on weekends. :wave:

Amaya Chen: welcome jordan!! super excited to have you. i'll DM you a 1:1 slot. buddy is @Lynn Patel — she'll help with day-to-day setup. for VPC/infra ping @Carlos (cc'd) and eng-infra-bot for invites. :tada:

Lynn Patel: hey jordan :wave: i'll set up a screenshare later today to walk through our repo + local dev container. check the MDM enroll doc before the call: https://intranet.redwood.com/mdm-enroll (quick steps in the top section).

Jordan Park: thanks amaya/lynn! my timezone is PST. i already got the onboarding checklist link but laptop shipping still shows "processing" on the tracker. is that normal?

Carlos Mendez: @Jordan Park i just created a ticket for IT pickup — ticket #IT-4921. ETA for shipping is 2–3 business days unless there are stock issues. i'll follow up here if anything changes. if you need a temporary dev VM, reply and we can provision one today.

it-helpdesk: Ticket IT-4921 has been updated: "Provisioned temporary cloud dev box (ubuntu-22.04)."
Details: ssh user=jpark, host=devbox-178.redwood.internal, key will be in your 1password folder under "IT Temporary Keys".

Jordan Park: great, thanks @Carlos and thanks IT. will try the SSH later. any recommended dotfiles or preferred editor settings?

Lynn Patel: we use "editorconfig" + shared eslint rules. i'll push a small starter dotfiles repo to your GitHub invite in ~10m. also make sure you accept the org invite for our repo org — eng-infra-bot should auto-add you but shout if it doesn't.

eng-infra-bot: Added Jordan Park to org "redwood-inference" and repo teams: inference-backend, inference-dev. Please accept the invite in your email.

Devon Lee: hey jordan — welcome! coffee question for onboarding: espresso or pour-over? also good to know: our weekly sync is Tuesdays 10am PT.

Jordan Park: pour-over all the way :coffee: and i've added the weekly sync to my calendar. thanks everyone — looking forward to diving in!

Amaya Chen: small onboarding note: we'll do a team intro at 4pm PT today — join if you can. one more fun fact request: share a tiny non-work thing you're proud of in this thread (plant, hobby, pet pic, whatever). Jordan — your ukulele/drumroll? :drum_with_drumsticks:

Jordan Park: i'll share a pic of my latest uke build in the channel after the 4pm intro. also i grow succulents and once propagated 42 at home, not that anyone asked :sunglasses:
